name: Sparklean Station Nigeria
what_they_do: Ilorin-based manufacturer of NAFDAC-approved, ammonia- and toxic-chemical-free household and commercial cleaning and disinfectant products (founded by Ameedah Eniola Olaniyan), supplying local retailers and exporting to Niamey, Niger Republic including white-label manufacturing.

investors: Cascador / Nigerian Youth Academy (NiYA) / Federal Ministry of Youth Development
